page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage options. For connectivity, the instance provides a high baseline network bandwidth of 80 Gbps, which supports high-throughput data transfers and inter-instance communication. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high network bandwidth make this instance suitable for enterprise-scale workloads requiring consistent processing power without resource contention. The balanced CPU-to-memory ratio of 1:4 makes it appropriate for general-purpose applications, medium-to-large databases, application servers, containerized microservices, and continuous integration pipelines that do not require local NVMe storage or hardware acceleration.
